title: FluoGene HLA NX 96-Well or 384-Well Setup
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Select tray format
steps.instruction: Indicate on the protocol page whether you will use 96‑well trays (two trays) or a single 384‑well tray (columns 1‑12).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the JSON protocol file from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded JSON file into the Opentrons (OT) App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the deck map: place the 96‑well or 384‑well tray(s), tip racks, reagent reservoir, and any other required labware in the positions shown in the map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and pipettes in the OT App. For the custom 384‑well tray, use the 384‑well tray calibration protocol (well diameter 2.5 mm) after completing the standard labware calibration.

steps.title: Dispense water and PCR mix
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel p20 pipette (rear‑most channel only), dispense 4 µL of water and then 4 µL of PCR mix into the last well of the first column of each tray.

steps.title: Mix DNA dilution with PCR mix
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel p300 pipette, combine the DNA dilution with the PCR mix, mix thoroughly, and transfer the resulting mixture to the reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Distribute mixture to assay wells
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel p20 pipette, dispense 8 µL of the DNA‑PCR mixture into each remaining well of the two 96‑well trays, or into columns 1‑12 of the single 384‑well tray.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: In the OT App, press “Run” to execute the protocol.
